How results are shown, in the chat (embedded) and on their own. A view is HTML with a script that reads DATA; built-in ones can be copied and changed. Views run sandboxed: they cannot fetch anything or reach dt, so everything they show comes in the data. The agent adds views with view_save and uses them with show.
